item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Chitra looks at the diagram of a closed shape with three corner points $A$, $B$ and $C$ joined by three straight sides.

Which claim correctly names the shape and its parts?

options.A: The shape is named only by the single corner $A$.
options.B: The shape is triangle $ABC$, with sides $AB$, $BC$ and $CA$, and angles at $A$, $B$ and $C$.
options.C: The shape is a triangle even if side $BC$ is left open.
options.D: The shape is a triangle because the letter $C$ is printed largest on the page.
